ask: can u make a two truths and a lie game from all the cabin stuff in here, the rest of us guess which one's fake
sentence: A two truths and a lie game where each round shows two real moments from a chat, one member writes a fake, the three are shuffled, the others guess the lie, and the author reveals it.
use_when: Group wants a guessing game built from real events or memories from the chat
After a trip, weekend or event, to play with the funny moments
Someone asks for two truths and a lie where the rest guess the fake
dont_use_when: Group wants a quiz with right answers from general knowledge or trivia
Group wants a vote or poll on a choice or plan
Players want a competitive board or card game with turns
